name: Creamy Garlic Herb Wine Pork Chops
ingredients: Salt and freshly ground pepper to taste
1/2 cup Parmesan cheese (or 1/4 cup almond flour, or 1/4 teaspoon xanthan gum)
why: Verified 497 cal / 7g carbs / 32g protein per source card - dead-center of the band, strong 32g protein, well under carb ceiling. Structurally low-carb (almond-flour dredge, cream/wine pan sauce, no starch). One-skillet, scales cleanly to 14. Almond flour and Italian seasoning have no board home (feature for the pricer-lane proving run; white-wine, heavy-cream, parmesan, garlic, thyme, lemons, chicken-broth, butter all map). Distinct sauce profile from other pork-chop entries.
